digest.component_or_area: complexity baseline wrapper and repository gate
propositions: Raw Ruff C901 scanner exits 1 and reports 69 production functions exceeding threshold 15, but raw exit codes cannot distinguish debt from errors, blocking all changes if added to lint without a wrapper.

Committed JSON baseline at .github/complexity-baseline.json maps repository-relative POSIX path and AST-qualified symbol keys to integer complexity ceilings, enabling per-function debt tracking without line-number churn.

Wrapper script check_complexity_baseline.py --check exits 0 only when all current Ruff findings equal or are below their recorded ceilings, rejecting new or increased debt while permitting stale (reduced or removed) entries to pass.
Guarded --update-stale maintenance mode lowers or removes stale baseline entries through atomic_write but refuses to write if new or increased debt exists, preventing silent regression bless.

Symbol identity derived from Python AST (nested function ancestry, async methods) disambiguates equal-leaf function names across scopes; duplicate same-qualified-key diagnostics fail normalization rather than overwrite.

Baseline JSON schema enforces structure (schema_version, sorted ceilings keys), valid path/symbol grammar (src/rebar/*.py::Ancestor.func), ceiling constraints (integer > 15), and rejects duplicates and unknown fields at parse time.
